reviews.title: Good for passing time
reviews.text: While this does live up to what it says in the ads about it, and it is good for just passing some time, there are a few things they could do better. One is the fact that some of the weekly challenge tasks don’t track. I use the hammer, but sometimes it doesn’t give me credit for using it in the weekly challenges. Also some of the puzzles seem to get glitchy to a point where you can’t move forward unless you use one of the tools. Also, what’s the point of the buildings if you aren’t going to include that in the weekly challenges at all? You used to, but I haven’t seen that for months. One of the tasks this week is “Rate this game.” I’ve done it before, but it doesn’t give me credit for completing the task. Glitchy!
